historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR (6.0%) is more than 30% below revenue (11.5%) and EPS (16.4%) CAGRs. Two known causes: FNV pays out ~20-25% of earnings as dividends (19 consecutive annual increases) and took the $1.2B Cobre Panama impairment through equity in FY2023 (-$466.4M net loss). Not a data error.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2022->FY2025 (3yr) and FY2020->FY2025 (5yr). FCF CAGRs use the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less equity-settled SBC less finance income): FY2020 793.1, FY2022 976.8, FY2025 1,454.1. Owner-FCF CAGRs are within 0.3pp of reported-FCF CAGRs because SBC is <0.5% of revenue; the gap that does exist comes from finance income rising with the cash pile (3.7 -> 28.2). EPS 5yr CAGR is inflated by the Q1 2020 impairment base (FY2020 EPS 1.71). All historical growth was gold-price-led (FY2025 revenue +64% on 519k GEOs vs 522k in FY2020): the forward base path holds gold flat at spot and runs ~4.4%/yr revenue CAGR FY2025->FY2035, below every historical CAGR by design.

scenario_narratives.base: Gold holds at today's ~$4,200/oz in nominal terms (below the company's $4,500 planning deck) and the existing portfolio delivers the midpoint of management's 2030 outlook (585k GEOs) through the Eskay Creek, Cascabel, Stibnite, Stillwater West and Detour ramp-ups, net of the Candelaria (H2 2027) and Antapaccay (H2 2028) stream step-downs. Cobre Panama contributes only the 2026-27 stockpile ounces. Margins stay ~90.5% pre-SBC, the cash tax rate ramps to the guided 20-23%, and 16% of revenue is reinvested each year just to replace depleting ounces. The result capitalises roughly NOPAT at 8%/2.5%, which is what the existing portfolio is worth as a going concern without crediting FNV for future accretive deals.
scenario_narratives.bull: Gold retests its January 2026 highs ($5,000 from 2027) as real rates fall and central-bank buying persists, and Panama's ministerial commission negotiates a Cobre Panama restart that ramps from 2028 to the 150-175k GEOs/yr the stream can deliver at full capacity. Margins widen to ~91-92% because stream costs are fixed in dollars, deals are priced more cheaply (14% sustaining reinvestment) and terminal growth of 3% reflects nominal gold drift plus the 300+ exploration-stage interests not in guidance.
scenario_narratives.bear: Gold mean-reverts to ~$3,300 by 2027 (a further ~20% fall after its worst quarter since 2013), Cobre Panama stays shut and stockpile deliveries slip, and the Candelaria and Antapaccay step-downs land without offset so volumes track the bottom of the outlook range. Fixed-dollar stream costs compress the margin to ~87%, the competitive deal market forces 20% of revenue into replacement acquisitions, and the premium the market pays royalty names over NAV compresses. There is no solvency dimension: FNV has no debt, $1.0B cash and $1.2B of listed investments.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Franco-Nevada is valued as the going-concern owner of a depleting royalty portfolio: the existing assets are projected to management's own five-year volume outlook at a flat spot gold price, a sustaining-reinvestment charge replaces depleted ounces so the terminal value capitalises earnings rather than pre-depletion operating cash flow, and the company's cash, listed investments, bullion and loans are added at fair value. Growth acquisitions beyond the outlook are assumed value-neutral and are neither projected nor charged. Gold-price risk and the Cobre Panama binary are carried in the scenarios, not in the discount rate, which is a USD cost of equity for an unlevered 90%-margin royalty business. The house DCF therefore says what the portfolio is worth without the premium-to-NAV the market has historically paid royalty companies; the gap between the weighted IV and the price is a measure of how much gold upside and deal-accretion credit the current quote embeds.
key_risks_to_valuation: Gold price: every $500/oz is roughly +/-12% of revenue with ~no offsetting cost change; the base case holds gold flat at spot, so a sustained move either way dominates every other assumption
Cobre Panama: a full restart is worth 150-175k GEOs/yr (~25-30% of guided volumes) and is in the bull case only; the bear and base cases carry nothing beyond the 2026-27 stockpile ounces

Sustaining-reinvestment charge: valuing a depleting portfolio requires a replacement-capital assumption (16% of revenue in base); at 14% or 20% the base IV moves by roughly +/-10%, and the choice is a judgment, not a disclosed number

Cash tax convergence: the cash rate is ramped from ~16% to 21.5%; if deferred-tax timing differences on streams persist longer, or Canadian transfer-pricing rules bite harder, the terminal NOPAT moves several percent

Candelaria/Antapaccay step-downs (H2 2027, H2 2028) and the timing of Cascabel, Eskay Creek and Stibnite first production: the 2027-2029 volume path depends entirely on third-party operators FNV cannot control

Market premium: royalty companies have traded at 1.5-2.5x P/NAV; the DCF does not model that premium, so the stock can trade far above the house IV for years while the premium persists, and fall toward it if gold enters a prolonged bear market

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted 193,504,280 at 2026-08-11 per Q2 2026 MD&A (192,873,810 outstanding + 542,212 options + 88,258 RSUs; FNV.TO_Quarterly_Q2-2026.txt:1791). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice. DRIP/option-exercise issuance has run ~0.2%/yr (192.6m FY2024 -> 193.3m Q2 2026) and is ignored as immaterial.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 consolidated statement of cash flows, 'Share-based compensation expenses' add-back $6.3M (equity-settled; FNV.TO_Annual_FY2025.txt:8631). Equity-award taxes: none disclosed (0). The income-statement charge incl. cash-settled DSU/PSU mark-to-market was $16.9M (FNV.TO_Annual_FY2025.txt:10501) and is already a cost inside the company's Adjusted EBITDA, so the EBITDA margin path below is stated PRE equity-settled SBC and the engine deducts sbc_pct_path once.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in USD; TSX quote in CAD. fx_rate is USD->CAD 1.4254 (Yahoo USDCAD=X, 2026-10-10T04:21Z). Parity check against the NYSE dual listing: FNV US$244.85 (2026-10-09 close) x 1.4254 = C$349.01 vs observed FNV.TO C$349.61, a 0.17% tie that confirms rate, direction and quote basis. All per-share values are computed in USD and converted at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in CAD to match current_price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are USD, so WACC is built in USD: 10-yr UST ~4.2% + beta 0.75 x ERP 5.0% = 7.95%, rounded to 8.0%. No debt (both revolvers undrawn at 2026-06-30; Debt-to-equity nil), so WACC = cost of equity. The low beta is the royalty model's own: ~90% EBITDA margins, zero operating/capital-cost exposure on 88-91% of revenue, 447 assets across 121 producing mines. Commodity-price and Cobre Panama risk are charged in the scenario flows, not stacked on the discount rate, and the same 8.0% is used in all three scenarios (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Immaterial. Lease-liability accretion was $0.1M in H1 2026 (FNV.TO_Quarterly_Q2-2026.txt:1325); office lease cost stays inside EBITDA costs (treatment B) and lease liabilities are excluded from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: None. No non-controlling interests; 100% of net income is attributable.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (dcf-methods routing table: operating company whose value is a stream of free cash flow; non-US filer with a quote currency different from the reporting currency, so the adaptations file was applied for currency, matching assets and charge-risk-once). Routed here rather than to the REIT/LIC rows because FNV's cash flows are operating royalty and stream receipts, not fair-value or distributable-profit series, and it carries no leverage; routed here rather than to a bare NAV because the market, the company's own five-year outlook and 300+ exploration-stage interests all treat the portfolio as a going concern with organic growth. ACQUISITIONS: the royalty portfolio depletes, and FNV's real reinvestment is royalty/stream acquisitions ($2,191.6M FY2025, $529.7M H1 2026), not plant capex ($5.1M FY2025). The build treats the two halves of that spend differently: (1) organic volume growth to the company's 2030 outlook (555-615k GEOs, from Cascabel 2028, Eskay Creek 2027, Stibnite 2029, Stillwater West 2028, Detour 1Moz by 2031, Candelaria/Antapaccay step-downs in H2 2027/H2 2028) is already paid for and is projected without any further charge; (2) a SUSTAINING-REINVESTMENT charge is carried in capex_pct_path (base 16% of revenue, bull 14%, bear 20%) representing the acquisition spend needed to replace depleted ounces and hold the GEO base flat into the terminal year. Calibration: book depletion guidance is $310-340M (~14% of FY2026E revenue) and a price-based estimate (2-3%/yr organic decline x ~$30k per annual GEO at 2025-26 deal pricing) gives ~$400-450M/yr, so 16% of revenue sits between the two. Growth acquisitions beyond the outlook are not projected and not charged (value-neutral at fair pricing). With capex ~ D&A the projected FCF is close to NOPAT, so the terminal value capitalises earnings, not pre-depletion OCF. GOLD PRICE: base holds gold flat at ~$4,200/oz (spot $4,216, 2026-10-09) from 2027 against the company's $4,500 guidance deck; bull $5,000 (retest of the Jan-2026 $5,400-5,600 highs) plus a Cobre Panama restart from 2028; bear $3,300 (a further ~20% fall after the >20% drawdown from the January peak; the 2025 average was ~$3,400) and no Cobre restart. Revenue is approximated as GEOs x gold price, which is what the fixed-ratio GEO framework intends; Diversified (oil/gas/iron ore, ~11% of revenue) is assumed to move with the rest. FY2026 year-1 growth of +31% is mostly already in H1 2026 actuals (revenue $1,231.6M, +67% YoY, 268,758 GEOs at ~$4,580/GEO); H2 is built at ~275k GEOs incl. ~27k GEOs of Cobre Panama stockpile deliveries (Q3 start) at ~$4,200. CASH TAX: the cash rate (FY2025 $162.0M paid on ~$1,416M pre-tax = 11%; H1 2026 ~15%) runs well below the 20-23% guided effective rate because deferred-tax timing differences on stream depletion defer tax; those reverse as assets deplete, Pillar Two tops Barbados up to 15% from 2024, and new Canadian transfer-pricing legislation applies from 2026, so the cash rate is ramped 16% -> 21.5% by FY2030 and held. INTEREST INCOME: FY2025 finance income $28.2M stripped from the FCF base since the $1,014M cash pile is added in the bridge. COBRE PANAMA: no contribution in base or bear (matches company guidance and outlook); stockpile ounces (~23,100 Au oz + 265,000 Ag oz through 2027) are in the FY2026-27 base volumes only; a full restart (150-175k GEOs/yr at full capacity) is bull-only. BAND POSITION: SBC is 0.35% of revenue, so the house/street band is a few CAD wide and the market price sits far outside it; the band position number is therefore not meaningful for this name and should be read as 'band collapsed'.

bear.growth_note: Gold falls to $3,300 by FY2027 (H2 2026 ~$3,900, lower-half volumes): FY2026 $2,300M; FY2027 530k x $3,300 = $1,749M (-24%); stockpile deliveries slip and Candelaria/Antapaccay step-downs are not offset, FY2028 flat; FY2029 540k, FY2030 555k = bottom of the outlook range. No Cobre Panama restart.
bear.capex_note: 20%: competitive bidding against Wheaton/Royal Gold/Triple Flag compresses returns on replacement deals, so more capital is needed per replaced ounce.
bear.da_note: Depletion is a dollar charge on book cost, so at $1,749M revenue the same ~$325M is 18.5% of revenue; this lowers cash tax but not pre-tax cash.

base.growth_note: FY2026 $2,390M: H1 actual $1,231.6M + H2 ~275k GEOs (incl. ~27k Cobre stockpile GEOs) at ~$4,200. FY2027 545k GEOs x $4,200 (Candelaria 68%->40% step-down H2 2027, Eskay Creek start, stockpile tail) = $2,289M, hence the -4.2%. FY2028 555k (Cascabel, Stillwater West, Antapaccay step-down), FY2029 570k (Stibnite), FY2030 585k = midpoint of the 555-615k outlook. FY2031-35: ~1% volume (Detour 1Moz) + ~2% nominal gold drift.
base.capex_note: Sustaining-reinvestment charge: acquisition spend needed to replace depleted ounces and hold volumes flat beyond the outlook. 16% of revenue ~ $380-450M/yr, between book depletion (~14%) and a price-based replacement estimate (~17-18%).
base.da_note: FY2026 depletion guidance $310-340M (midpoint $325M = 13.6% of $2,390M). Rises to ~14% of revenue as acquired assets add depletion while flat gold holds revenue.
base.tax_note: Cash rate ramps from ~16% toward the 20-23% guided effective rate as deferred-tax timing on streams reverses, Pillar Two applies and 2026 Canadian transfer-pricing rules bite.

bull.growth_note: Gold $5,000 from FY2027 (H2 2026 ~$4,400). FY2026 $2,461M; FY2027 550k x $5,000 = $2,750M; Cobre Panama full restart ramps from 2028 (+80k, +150k, +165k GEOs) on top of the organic path: FY2028 640k = $3,200M, FY2029 730k = $3,650M, FY2030 765k x $5,100 = $3,900M. FY2031-35 3-4% (volume + nominal drift).
bull.capex_note: 14%: deals priced more cheaply in a scarce-capital market plus more exploration-driven reserve replacement by operators.
bull.da_note: D&A $ roughly fixed on a higher revenue base (11.8%), lifted back to 12% as Cobre Panama's ~$1.3B carrying value starts depleting.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 default to a symmetric 25/50/25. Bull weight is cut because the bull case needs two independent things to go right at once: gold back to $5,000 AND a negotiated Cobre Panama restart that Panama's government has given no timeline for. Bear weight is raised because gold is a two-way commodity that has already fallen >20% from its January peak, and FNV's revenue has no cost cushion against a further leg down; there is no going-concern element, so the bear case is a price case, not a solvency case.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
